title: The Garden That We Grew
author: Joan Holub

hero.name: Pumpkin (giant pumpkin)

hero.source_note: Generic pumpkin icon available in Boardmaker library

notes: This rhyming picture book follows a group of children planting a pumpkin seed through to harvest. The pumpkin itself is the most recognisable central object and makes a strong hero icon — it is already in the existing activity_images vocab which is ideal. Several existing vocab items (seed, vine) are reused from the existing library. 'Water' here refers to the action of watering plants, not water as a drink — the icon_search_term 'water plant' clarifies this. 'Big' is included because the pumpkin growing to giant size is a core narrative payoff students will want to comment on. 'Orange' is included as a colour because naming the pumpkin's colour is a key concrete communication opportunity. 'Earth/dirt' replaces a more abstract word to keep vocabulary concrete and picturable.
